Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"markdown\",\"max_chars\":500,\"max_overlap\":50,\"trim\":true}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().chunks)
}
```
